title: Lifecycles
intro: The only spec.lifecycle values catalog files may use — one global list for every kind that carries the field. Administrators curate the list and its order.
valueInvalid: Must be 1–63 lowercase alphanumeric characters with single dashes
valueDuplicate: This lifecycle is already in the list
discardMessage: Your unsaved lifecycle changes will be lost.
savedButStale: Saved — but reloading the editor failed. Reload the page before making further changes.

error.conflict: Save conflict — swapping two values needs two saves; rename through a temporary value first
error.validation: One or more values are invalid
error.saveFailed: Save failed. Check your connection and try again.
